10 Reduction in Sentence for a Guilty Plea Definitive Guideline
Effective from 1 June 2017

REDUCTION IN SENTENCE FOR A GUILTY PLEA
Appendix 2
Flowchart illustrating reductions for summary only offences
(offences that can be tried only in a magistrates’ court)
This flowchart is provided as an illustration of the operation of the guideline as at 1 June 2017.
It does not form part of the guideline.
The reductions and timings are subject to the exceptions set out in the guideline
